2607.01401.title: NeuroBridge: Bridging Multi-Task MRI Knowledge for Neurodegenerative Disease Diagnosis
2607.01401.paper_summary: INTRODUCTION: Accurate MRI-based identification of Alzheimer's disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and related dementias remains challenging because disease-related structural changes are often subtle and heterogeneous. We developed NeuroBridge, a clinically guided multi-task MRI framework for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis. METHODS: NeuroBridge integrates large-scale self-supervised MRI pretraining with hippocampal segmentation, hippocampal atrophy classification, and reconstruction objectives, followed by gated fusion fine-tuning. Performance was evaluated across ADNI and OASIS cohorts, including cross-cohort transfer, probability-based analysis, and opportunistic screening. RESULTS: NeuroBridge achieved the highest performance across evaluated classification tasks, reaching 88.17% accuracy for AD versus cognitively normal controls in ADNI and 82.78% in OASIS. The largest gains occurred in MCI-related and mixed-diagnosis settings. The framework demonstrated strong cross-cohort generalization, systematic associations between predicted-class probability and accuracy, and the feasibility of probability-based opportunistic screening. DISCUSSION: Clinically guided multi-task representation learning improves neurodegenerative MRI diagnosis beyond conventional single-task approaches. NeuroBridge provides a robust and scalable framework for dementia assessment and MRI-based opportunistic screening.
2607.01401.paper_summary_zh: INTRODUCTION: 基於MRI的阿茲海默症（AD）、輕度認知障礙（MCI）及相關癡呆的準確識別仍然具有挑戰性，因為與疾病相關的結構變化往往是微妙且異質的。 我們開發了NeuroBridge，一個臨床指導的多任務MRI框架，用於神經退行性疾病的診斷。 METHODS: NeuroBridge整合了大規模自我監督的MRI預訓練，與海馬體分割、海馬體萎縮分類和重建目標，隨後進行門控融合微調。 性能在ADNI和OASIS隊列中進行評估，包括跨隊列轉移、基於概率的分析和機會篩查。 RESULTS: NeuroBridge在評估的分類任務中達到了最高性能，在ADNI中對比認知正常對照的準確率達到88.17%，在OASIS中達到82.78%。 在與MCI相關和混合診斷的環境中，最大的增益發生。 該框架展示了強大的跨隊列泛化、預測類別概率與準確性之間的系統性關聯，以及基於概率的機會篩查的可行性。 DISCUSSION: 臨床指導的多任務表示學習改善了神經退行性MRI診斷，超越了傳統的單任務方法。 NeuroBridge提供了一個穩健且可擴展的癡呆評估和基於MRI的機會篩查框架。
